title: Juicy Indian Cherry Tomatoes Skewers
description: Buttery and snappy, these Indian cherry tomatoes skewers are a delicious monsoon Indian dish, featuring cherry tomatoes steamed in a leaf wrap and grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread 3-4 cherry tomato halves onto each skewer.
In a small bowl, mix together the melted butter, ghee, garam masala, cilantro, lemon juice, and salt.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the cherry tomatoes.
Wrap each skewer in a banana leaf, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the skewers on the robata grill and cook for 5-7 minutes, turning occasionally.
Steam the skewers for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cherry tomatoes are tender.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
